value.content:
This whole video came from one sentence. I typed the sentence in Claude Code, it wrote the JSON, and my library rendered it: a number, a chart, a timeline, a comparison, with my cloned voice and me in a window.

What you see: motion-kit, a library of video components for Remotion, with 47 ready-made visual styles and a tool that builds a vertical video from a JSON with 15 scene types. inspect checks the JSON before rendering and review makes one frame per scene. The library draws more than the JSON asks for today: maps, graphs, archival photos, documents, split screens, floating windows.

The numbers on screen come from the kit's own repository (git log of 2026-10-25): 312 commits in 104 days; 6 scenes in 19.6 s; 3 inspect warnings; −15.3 LUFS.

No Claude Motion involved: this is Claude Code plus my library in a Remotion project.

Open source (MIT): [LINK]

The presenter is a drawing made from my photos; the voice is mine, cloned by AI.

#Shorts #Remotion #ClaudeCode #motiongraphics #AI #opensource
